entities.summary: Maria Rita Kehl, ORB is a Brazilian psychoanalyst, journalist, poet, essayist, cronista and literary critic. In 2010, she won the Jabuti Award in the Education, Psychology and Psychoanalysis category  and the Human Rights Award from the Brazilian government in the Media and Human Rights category.
